Pay rate as interim head coach is according to what school termed an 'Offer Sheet,' rather than a full-form contract.

School Pay, Maximum Bonus and School Buyout amounts based on summary of contract amendment terms approved by university's governing board on June 7, 2024, not a full-form contract. School Pay includes $450,000 retention payment made to Painter for being school's head coach as of Sept. 1, 2024; in future years, this amount is scheduled to be $250,000 annually. School Pay also includes monthly supplemental retirement contributions that will total $300,000 if Painter remains coach through June 30, 2025. UCLA.note: School Pay includes $2 million retention payment Cronin will receive if he remains UCLA's head coach on April 15, 2025. This payment would cover Cronin's completion of a time period that began April 1, 2022. While the payment-trigger date is after the completion of Cronin's 2024-25 contract year, March 31, 2025, the university's athletics department said the parties' intent was for Cronin to receive a retention payment every three years of a six-year contract that is set to expire March 31, 2028, when Cronin would receive another $2 million. So, the university considers this payment to be for completing the 2024-25 season.

Washington.note: School Pay includes $400,000 one-time lump sum "relocation allowance" that Sprinkle must repay if he terminates the contract without cause or is fired for cause before March 25, 2025. In addition to School Pay, Washington agreed to pay Utah State $2,898,781 on Sprinkle's behalf to cover the buyout he owed for leaving that school. Washington agreed to pay this amount in monthly installments through March 31, 2028, or pursuant to such other terms to which the university and Utah State may agree. School said it paid Sprinkle $100,000 bonus based on team's NCAA Academic Progress Rate figure for 2023-24 academic year.

Arizona State.note: School Pay includes $600,000 retention payment that vested to Hurley on Jan. 2, 2025, but will not actually be paid to him unless he remains Arizona State's head coach through Jan. 1, 2026, or he is fired without cause before that date.

Iowa State.note: School Pay based on $200,000 in life insurance premium payments and $300,000 in supplemental-retirement-plan payments having been made by the university in their entirety, rather than on a pro-rated basis, before new contract terms and a $4 million annual pay rate took effect Jan. 1, 2025 -- halfway through Otzelberger's contract year. School is entitled to reimbursement of the $200,000 insurance premium payments from the policy's death benefits. School says it is adjusting its first six months of payments to Otzelberger under the new contract to make up for the insurance-premium and supplemental-retirement-plan amounts having already been paid in full.
